transcript: My name is Mohamed Rosam and I am a recent computing graduate preparing for machine learning engineer role. I have practiced Python, skip learning and pandas to academic work and small projects. One project I work on was inventory tracking dashboard in inventory management domain. My main contribution was stock update and dashboard views. The main issue was data mismatch between reports and records. So I checked the problem and discussed it with my team at the end the system reduced manual checking and improved stock visibility. I am applying for this role because I want to real industry expose and a chance to improve my technical skills. My strength is team collaboration but I still need to improve answering under pressure.

better_answer_example: As a recent computing graduate with a strong foundation in Python, scikit-learn, and pandas, I'm excited to apply for the machine learning engineer role. In my previous project, an inventory tracking dashboard, I utilized machine learning algorithms to predict stock levels and reduce manual checking. I worked closely with my team to identify and resolve data mismatch issues, resulting in improved stock visibility and reduced errors. I'm eager to bring my skills and experience to a real-world industry setting and continue to develop my technical expertise, particularly in areas like model deployment and hyperparameter tuning.
